stack-versions.text: Spring Boot 4.1.1 parent BOM, Java 21, Maven wrapper; Next.js 15.5.25, React 19.1.0, Tailwind 4, TypeScript 5. H2 runtime + PostgreSQL runtime in backend/pom.xml. Deps: webmvc, data-jpa, validation, actuator.

code-conventions.text: No Lombok: manual getters/setters with guard clauses throwing IllegalArgumentException in constructors and setters. Entities extend BaseEntity (audit fields). Package com.fintech.ledger.PaymentGateway. Repository tests use H2; Payment.record() owns status transitions; Payment.capturedAmountInUsd() computes captures net of refunds via Currency.getUsdRate().

decisions.text: system-design.md decision: monolithic Spring Boot module, /api REST prefix, error body {status,error,message,timestamp} via RestControllerAdvice, idempotent POST /api/payments by idempotencyKey returning 200 on duplicate, 409 on illegal state transition, H2 dev / Postgres prod, static X-API-Key auth (TASK-04). Revisit triggers documented in docs/system-design.md section 7.

boot4-h2console.text: Spring Boot 4 moved the H2 console servlet into org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-h2console (runtime scope). Without it, spring.h2.console.enabled=true silently does nothing and /h2-console 404s. Verified 2026-09-17 against docs.spring.io/spring-boot/reference/data/sql.html.

boot4-package-layout.text:
Boot 4 test annotations live in new packages: org.springframework.boot.data.jpa.test.autoconfigure.DataJpaTest, org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.WebMvcTest. Use spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test / spring-boot-starter-data-jpa-test artifacts. Hibernate 7 auto-detects dialect; never set spring.jpa.database-platform explicitly.
 MockMvc auto-config annotation: org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureMockMvc.

api-error-contract.text: GlobalExceptionHandler returns {status, error, message, timestamp}: 400 MethodArgumentNotValid, 404 NotFoundException, 409 DuplicateEmailException, 500 fallback (message logged, generic body). TASK-03 reuses it; only new exception types need mapping.

domain-ledger-invariants.text: Payment.record() rejects illegal transitions (IllegalStateException -> 409 via GlobalExceptionHandler). FAILED transactions always recorded and set status FAILED regardless of current state. FEE type has no transition yet (TASK-08). Ledger rows persist ONLY through Payment's CascadeType.ALL: an extra transactionRepository.save() double-inserted rows and made capturedAmountInUsd report 140 instead of 70.

auth-model.text: TASK-04: ApiKeyAuthFilter (plain jakarta Filter via FilterRegistrationBean, /api/payments/* only, order 1). X-API-Key -> MerchantRepository.findByApiKey; unknown/missing -> 401, non-ACTIVE merchant -> 403, else authenticatedMerchantId request attribute consumed by PaymentController @RequestAttribute. Merchant/actuator endpoints stay open (MVP admin trust). Body merchantId != authenticated id -> 403. Filter JSON errors written via tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper (Jackson 3 moved from com.fasterxml in Boot 4). Cross-merchant READS intentionally allowed; revisit trigger documented in docs/plans/TASK-04.md.
